name: The Baby-Sitters Club
description: In this contemporary take on the beloved book series, five best friends launch a baby-sitting business that's big on fun and adventure.

videos.title: Kristy's Great Idea
videos.overview: A creative concept comes to life as Kristy starts a club with her best friends — and a new classmate. But is she ready to be a team leader?

videos.title: Claudia and the Phantom Phone Calls
videos.overview: The spooky spirit of Halloween sweeps through Stoneybrook. Meanwhile, Claudia explores budding romance and struggles to connect with her parents.

videos.title: The Truth About Stacey
videos.overview: As competition heats up for the BSC, Stacey attempts to hide a personal secret and revisits a painful event from her past.

videos.title: Mary Anne Saves the Day
videos.overview: After dealing with a major dad dilemma, Mary Anne makes a dynamic new friend. Later, a medical emergency puts her caretaking skills to the test.

videos.title: Dawn and the Impossible Three
videos.overview: To prove herself to the BSC, Dawn agrees to babysit for a family of rowdy kids. Can she keep up with their mischief and mayhem?

videos.title: Claudia and Mean Janine
videos.overview: A family emergency triggers an emotional feud between Claudia and her older sister. Elsewhere, Mary Anne works to hide her feelings.

videos.title: Boy-Crazy Stacey
videos.overview: Mary Anne and Stacey team up for an out-of-town job: babysitting kids at the beach. But a cute new crush challenges business and friendship.

videos.title: Kristy's Big Day
videos.overview: Stoneybrook delights in a day of glitz and glamour as Kristy's mom prepares for a big day. Later, Kristy hits a major milestone, much to her surprise.

videos.title: Hello, Camp Moosehead! (1)
videos.overview: The BSC braves the great outdoors at a summer sleepaway camp, where they explore archery, theater, activism ... and a dash of chilling mystery.

videos.title: Hello, Camp Moosehead! (2)
videos.overview: As Stacey deals with a new normal, Kristy leads a crucial search, Dawn and Claudia start a revolution, and Mary Anne finds her place in the spotlight.

videos.title: Kristy and the Snobs
videos.overview: After moving in with Watson, Kristy navigates a not-so-warm neighborly welcome. The BSC helps Mary Anne define her post-camp relationship status.

videos.title: Claudia and the New Girl
videos.overview: A slumber party quiz sparks intrigue, uncertainty and an awkward beginning for Claudia and Mallory. Elsewhere, Kristy learns to let go of control.

videos.title: Stacey's Emergency
videos.overview: The BSC prepares to rule the runway as Stacey's special guests for a gala fashion show. But a series of concerning symptoms challenge the glitz and glam.

videos.title: Jessi and the Superbrat
videos.overview: Passion meets persistence as Jessi struggles with a rough patch in her ballet career, all while signing on to babysit a pint-sized vlogging superstar.

videos.title: Mary Anne and the Great Romance
videos.overview: As Dawn and Mary Anne await big news from their mom and dad, Logan sweeps in with a Valentine's Day surprise. But is it too much too soon?

videos.title: Dawn and the Wicked Stepsister
videos.overview: Worlds collide — and tension boils over — when Mary Anne and her dad move in with Dawn and her mom. The BSC plans a major party for Mallory's sister.

videos.title: Claudia and the Sad Goodbye
videos.overview: A heartbreaking turn of events redefines Claudia's life and — with loving support from her friends and family — pushes her out of her comfort zone.

videos.title: Kristy and the Baby Parade
videos.overview: The return of the Stoneybrook Baby Parade leads to a crafty (and chaotic) project for the BSC — and a bittersweet surprise for Kristy and her family.
